⚖️ Price per 100g Calculator

Find out how much a product costs per 100 grams and easily compare different sizes and brands.

Price per 100g

How to calculate the price per 100g

The price per 100 grams calculator makes it easier to compare products sold in different package sizes. Instead of looking only at the total price, you can use the same 100 g reference for every product.

The formula is simple: divide the product price by its weight in grams and multiply the result by 100.

Price per 100g example

If a 400 g product costs £3.20, divide 3.20 by 400 and multiply the result by 100. The result is £0.80 per 100 grams.

¿Qué es the price per 100g calculator?

Enter the product price and weight to calculate the cost per 100 grams. Useful for comparing food products with different package sizes.

Preguntas frecuentes

How do you calculate the price per 100 grams?

Divide the product price by its weight in grams and multiply the result by 100. For example, a 500 g product costing £4 has a price of £0.80 per 100 g.

Why calculate the price per 100g?

It gives you a common measurement for comparing products with different weights and package sizes.

Can I enter the weight in kilograms?

The calculator uses grams. If the product weighs 1 kilogram, enter 1000 grams.

Can I use this calculator for food?

Yes. It is useful for comparing products such as coffee, cheese, cereals, chocolate, nuts, meat and many other foods sold by weight.

Is price per gram the same as price per 100 grams?

No. Price per gram tells you the cost of one gram, while price per 100 grams multiplies that amount by 100 to provide a more convenient comparison.
